role.description: The user's role within the application.

IngredientMaster.title: IngredientMaster
IngredientMaster.description: Represents a master record of an ingredient, synchronized from Poster.

id.description: The Poster ID of the ingredient or product.

type.description: The type of item in Poster.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Represents a category for inventory items, typically synchronized from the Poster system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Category entity.

description.description: A detailed description of the category.

posterCategoryId.description: The unique identifier for this category in the external Poster system. Used for automatic synchronization. (Relationship: Poster 1:1 Category)

Location.title: Location
Location.description: Represents a physical or logical location where inventory is stored, enabling transfers and location-specific stock management.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Location entity.

name.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Main Warehouse', 'Shop Floor A').

description.description: A detailed description of the location.

address.description: The physical address of the location.

InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description: Represents a single stock-keeping unit (SKU) or product managed in the inventory, tracking its details and current stock. In this context, it often represents an ingredient from Poster.

id.description: Unique identifier for the InventoryItem entity.

name.description: The common name of the inventory item.

description.description: A detailed description of the inventory item, including specifications or usage.

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit, a unique code for the item used for identification and tracking.

currentStock.description: The current total quantity of this item across all known locations. This field represents the aggregated stock level.

unitOfMeasure.description: The standard unit in which the item is measured (e.g., 'pcs', 'kg', 'liter').

categoryId.description: Reference to the Category this inventory item belongs to. (Relationship: Category 1:N InventoryItem)

posterProductId.description: The unique identifier for this product in the external Poster system (e.g., ingredient_id). Used for automatic stock updates and price tracking. (Relationship: Poster 1:1 InventoryItem)

PriceRecord.title: PriceRecord
PriceRecord.description: A record of an ingredient's price at a specific point in time, usually from a supply.

price.description: The price of the ingredient per unit.

date.description: The timestamp of when this price was recorded.

supplierId.description: The ID of the supplier for this price record.

SandboxItem.title: SandboxItem
SandboxItem.description: Represents a draft menu item created in the sandbox.

name.description: The name of the sandbox item.

userId.description: The ID of the user who created this sandbox item.

totalCost.description: The total calculated cost of all ingredients.

PendingSupply.title: PendingSupply
PendingSupply.description: A supply request waiting for approval.

definition.description: Stores supply requests awaiting approval. Regular users can create their own, admins can manage all.
Subcollection to store the historical price data for each ingredient. `ingredientId` is the Poster ID, `priceId` is the Poster Supply ID.
Master data for ingredients, synchronized from Poster. Used to populate selection dropdowns.
Stores draft menu items created in the Sandbox. These are user-owned.
